messages:
Priya Singh: Heads-up: CrossRun adapter v0.9 validated but streaming/KV mismatch with LlamaIndex. Need quick decision on marketplace labeling.
Darren Cole: Can we show a partial-compat badge instead of holding the listing?
Leah Kim: Technical summary: adapter negotiates 1024-token streaming chunks; our gateway eager hydrates KV shards at 256 which causes memory spikes and p95 regression.
Sam - Integrations: Reprobed locally, streaming falls back to buffer flush -> ~2s extra.
Priya Singh: Options: (A) Block listing till fix, (B) Beta badge + disclaimer, (C) temp server-side clamp to 256 to preserve UX. Thoughts?
Leah Kim: Server-side clamp is low-risk; I'll implement a config flag to clamp handshake to 256 tokens and add unit tests.
Marta (Partner PM): Partner wants announcement next week. If fix is <3 business days they can keep timeline.
Tess - Marketplace: If legal approves a disclaimer we can list as "Beta-compatible (streaming: best-effort)".
Lina Legal: Draft disclaimer phrasing OK. Will provide final text by EOD 2026-04-25. Need SLA note for "best-effort streaming".
integrations-bot: CI started for branch crossrun-clamp-256.
Sam - Integrations: I'll prepare sample terraform + onboarding snippets for marketplace assets. Ready by 2026-04-24.
Darren Cole: I'll draft a short engineering blurb + perf bullets once Leah posts smoke results.
Priya Singh: Action items and dates: Leah - clamp PR & tests (2026-04-23), H100/A10G smoke (2026-04-24); Sam - terraform/runbook (2026-04-24); Lina - legal copy (2026-04-25); Marta/Tess - marketing badge & co-announcement draft (2026-04-26).
Leah Kim: Will push PR today and post smoke links tomorrow.
Priya Singh: If tests + smoke pass we proceed with beta marketplace listing and joint blog the week of 2026-05-11; if not, we delay. Thanks everyone.
